Lists the RO Number and Contract Number for every new folder (not already found in the existing-folders list) among equipment, contract crews, and contract overhead. VIPR rows get their real contract number; EERA rows get "Check AIMS Tracker" instead, since they don't have one. IROC doesn't export a CLIN number, so that column is left blank — fill it in as you process each contract in the Agreement Processor tab.
If this XML export includes an Incident Management Team, "Download CTR Roster for Team" builds a CIMT CTR Generator roster template with every team member's name, Resource Order Number, and (where the appointment type is recognized) classification already filled in — just add email, dates, and shift times, and double-check any classification left blank, then upload it in the CIMT CTR Generator tab. Only applies to the IMT itself, not other resources on the incident. If the export has more than one IMT, choose which one above before downloading.

Fill in the incident info above (applied to every CTR), then download the template, fill one row per person, and upload it back. The template is a proper Excel table: First/Last Work Day are real date columns (click and pick a date, or type one), and Classification is a dropdown limited to FED, AD, or EFF/COOP. Each row becomes one CTR covering every day from First Work Day through Last Work Day (max 22 days — longer spans need to be split into two rows/forms). Times are 24-hour, e.g. 0600. Lunch Time is when lunch starts — a standard 30-minute unpaid lunch is assumed, so lunch end is calculated automatically. If someone isn't taking a lunch, just leave Lunch Time blank and the whole shift is entered as straight time. Any shift that totals over 16 hours (lunch excluded) is flagged so you can double-check it. Rows with a name filled in but no dates and/or times yet (e.g. right after importing a team roster) are skipped quietly rather than shown as errors — fill those in and re-run "Preview Roster" once their dates/times are known.

For filling out your own Individual Crew Time Report by hand, without a roster spreadsheet. Covers every day from First Work Day through Last Work Day automatically (max 22 days per form — longer assignments need a second CTR). Times are 24-hour, e.g. 0600. Leave Lunch Time blank if you're not required to take one — the whole shift is entered as straight time instead. Shifts over 16 hours (lunch excluded) are blocked so you can double-check the times before generating.
CTR Preview

⚠️ OCR (used for reading scanned Agreements, Resource Orders, and OF-286s) is currently in beta testing and can be unreliable, especially on handwriting and low-quality scans. Freshly downloaded, unscanned documents straight from VIPR, IROC, and e-iSuite are still preferred whenever you have them — use OCR results as a starting point to verify, not a final answer.

All processing happens in your browser — no document or image data is ever sent to any server, including for the OCR fallback used on scanned OF-286s.
